# Paulo Chang

> Senior backend engineer in Berlin with more than ten years of backend work for large brands, mostly on Adobe Experience Manager, Java and serverless. Backend Community AI Champion at Cognizant Netcentric, where Paulo built and maintains an internal AI tooling marketplace for backend developers and runs the training that goes with it. Looking for a leadership role focused on AI adoption in software development.

This is a personal professional profile plus a small number of self-contained side projects. Every page publishes a Markdown alternate of its content, declared in the HTML via `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` and linked directly below. The Markdown files are served as `text/markdown` and are the preferred source for agents: they carry the same text as the rendered pages without the layout markup.

Canonical host: https://paulochang.com/

## Profile

- [Home](https://paulochang.com/index.md): name, role, and links.
- [About](https://paulochang.com/about/index.md): background and current focus areas.
- [Resume](https://paulochang.com/resume/index.md): complete role history (Cognizant Netcentric, Hyggs, earlier AEM platform work), skills and stack, certifications, and spoken languages.

## Projects

- [Projects index](https://paulochang.com/projects/index.md): listing page linking to the tools below.
- [BSR Straßenreinigung Berlin](https://paulochang.com/berlin-cleaning/index.md): Interactive MapLibre GL map of Berlin's official street-cleaning classes (Reinigungsklassen), bilingual German/English, with address search and per-class filtering. The live page at https://paulochang.com/berlin-cleaning/ renders client-side, so the Markdown is a description rather than a transcript.
- [A Moment of Light](https://paulochang.com/quotes/index.md): Shows one short poem at a time from a small collection stored in the page. The live page at https://paulochang.com/quotes/ generates its content in the browser.
- [Syntax-Aware Diff Tool](https://paulochang.com/diff/index.md): A browser-based diff tool built around the Monaco diff editor, with side-by-side/inline views, drag-and-drop input, and live change metrics. The live page at https://paulochang.com/diff/ renders client-side, so the Markdown is a description rather than a transcript.
- [JSON Query Tool (JSONata)](https://paulochang.com/json/index.md): A three-panel workbench for exploring JSON — input, structure explorer, and a JSONata query box with autocomplete and live results. The live page at https://paulochang.com/json/ renders client-side, so the Markdown is a description rather than a transcript.
- [Geometric Wall Designer](https://paulochang.com/paint/index.md): Generates wall patterns you can paint with masking tape: straight lines only, at most three colors. The live page at https://paulochang.com/paint/ renders client-side, so the Markdown is a description rather than a transcript.
- [Traffic](https://paulochang.com/traffic/index.md): The 40 classic Rush Hour-style sliding-block traffic puzzles — slide vehicles out of the way to free the red car, with a move counter, timer, and offline installable play via a service worker. The live page at https://paulochang.com/traffic/ renders client-side, so the Markdown is a description rather than a transcript.
- [CCAR-F Study Guide](https://paulochang.com/study-guide/index.md): A self-contained offline study guide for the Claude Certified Architect (Foundations) exam, compiled into one zero-dependency HTML file. The live page at https://paulochang.com/study-guide/ is a static document reader.
